description: This file defines default and on-premises server configuration settings for Mattermost, including functions to retrieve and merge configurations, and detailed configuration objects for various server components.

methods.name: getOnPremServerConfig
methods.description: Returns the combined on-premises server configuration by merging default and specific settings.

methods.name: mergeWithOnPremServerConfig
methods.description: Merges provided overrides with the current server configuration to produce a new configuration object.
